title: DueDateRule
description: Schema for encoding computable due date rules for recurring compliance obligations

fixed_day.description: Day of month for FIXED_ANNUAL rule type

fixed_month.description: Month for FIXED_ANNUAL rule type. NOTE: For post-FY-end filings (e.g., May 30 for LLP Form 11), this refers to the calendar year AFTER the FY ends.

fixed_in_year_context.description: For FIXED_ANNUAL: which calendar year does fixed_month/fixed_day apply to?
examples: CURRENT_FY_YEAR: June 15 advance tax — in the current FY year
AFTER_FY_END_YEAR: May 30 LLP Form 11 — in the year after FY ends
ASSESSMENT_YEAR: July 31 ITR — in the AY year

ay_fixed_day.description: Day of month for FIXED_IN_AY rule type

ay_fixed_month.description: Month in Assessment Year calendar for FIXED_IN_AY rule type

period_type.description: For OFFSET_FROM_PERIOD_END: what kind of period does the offset apply to?

offset_days.description: Number of days after period end for OFFSET_FROM_PERIOD_END

period_end_day_override.description: If the period doesn't end on last day of month/quarter, specify the last day

applicable_quarters.description: For quarterly rules: which FY quarters does this rule apply to? [1,2,3,4] for all.

fy_end_offset_days.description: For OFFSET_FROM_FY_END: days after March 31 of FY

agm_offset_days.description: For OFFSET_FROM_AGM: days after the date of AGM

agm_deadline_as_fallback.description: For OFFSET_FROM_AGM: if actual AGM date not provided, use AGM deadline (Sep 30)?

event_offset_days.description: For OFFSET_FROM_EVENT: days after the user-supplied event date

advance_tax_cumulative_pct.description: For ADVANCE_TAX_INSTALLMENT: cumulative % of estimated tax due by this date

state_based_variation.description: Whether due date varies by state (e.g., GSTR-3B 20th/22nd/24th staggering)

state_offset_rules.description: Array of state-group offset rules. Used when state_based_variation is true.

group_label.description: Human-readable label, e.g. 'Group A - Large States'

fixed_day.description: If this state group has a fixed day rather than offset

working_day_rule.description: How to adjust if the computed due date falls on a Sunday or public holiday

special_march_rule.description: Special rule for March period (e.g., TDS March deposit → April 30)

march_fixed_month.description: Month of the override (e.g., 4 for April 30)

notification_override_possible.description: Whether government notifications may override this due date

active_override_source_id.description: If a notification is currently extending this due date, the source_id of that notification

active_override_due_date.description: The actual extended due date per current override

active_override_expires.description: When the current override expires (the base rule resumes after this)

rule_description.description: Human-readable description of how this due date is computed

state_offset_rules.group_label: Group C — NE States and Small UTs

examples.rule_description: GSTR-3B is due on the 20th/22nd/24th (state-dependent) of the month following the return period. For return period April 2025: due May 20/22/24 2025 depending on state.
examples.rule_notes: State groupings are as per latest CBIC Notification under Central Tax. VERIFY current notification before populating state_offset_rules. Group C states may be updated.

examples.rule_description: ITR for non-audit cases is due on July 31 of the Assessment Year. For FY2025-26: due July 31, 2026.
examples.rule_notes: CBDT has historically extended this due date for various FYs. Always check for current-year extension notification.

examples.rule_description: First advance tax installment: 15% of estimated annual tax liability due by June 15 of the current FY.
